packageRules.description: Node.js is pinned in mise.toml and in every workflow; update them together.
Packages of the Solid monorepo are released in lockstep and @solidjs/web peer-depends on the same solid-js patch version.
The Lambda runtime in Terraform must change together with the build image minor version.
mise resolves postgres to conda:postgresql on conda-forge, but Renovate looks it up without the channel.
The PostgreSQL major version follows the production RDS engine_version (Terraform); update CI, compose.yml, mise.toml and RDS together.
